undated_mentions: Taken in by paternal grandfather after father's riding accident
Went to live with maternal relatives in Kentucky and attended a Catholic girls school
Moved near Centerville (later Kearney, Missouri) with Robert James
Received compensation from Pinkerton for son's death and her injury
